entities.name: Thérèse de Kermel

entities.summary: Comtesse de Kermel or Thérèse de Kermel, née Thérèse Villard was a French tennis player at the beginning of the 20th century. She won the French Championships in singles in 1907 over runner up Mlle d'Elva.
